يكترون (form VIII)
# يَكْتَرُونَ (yaktarūna) /jak.ta.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَرَى (iktarā)
# يُكْتَرَوْنَ (yuktarawna) /juk.ta.raw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَرَى (iktarā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
